scope: local Windows Docker Desktop Linux VM; no production connection
limitations: 2 MiB per transfer, 3 repetitions per direction: functional/causal lab, not WAN capacity ranking
qdisc counters in this run captured BEFORE transfers, not measured packet loss
netem random loss has no fixed seed; GSO/offload and VM scheduling may affect results
no independent cold TLS handshake or end-to-end WAN RTT measurement
TLS fixture uses isolated private CA; production certificate is not involved
